edges.effect_quant: Different designs and subgroups point in different directions, so a single pooled estimate is not the right way to read this edge.
edges.mechanism: Testosterone can shift hematocrit, thrombosis risk, and fluid balance while also changing body composition, which is why cardiovascular effects remain controversial.
edges.summary: What makes this pair believable is not one flashy paper but the way the literature stacks up: the 2024 Jaiswal meta analysis in Prog Cardiovasc Dis already points to testosterone replacement therapy produces mixed findings across studies, and later studies mostly refine the size of the effect rather than overturning it. In practice this reads more like a real risk signal than a one-off finding.
edges.caveats: This is a contested edge. Exposure measurement, confounding, and publication-era effects all matter, so confidence should stay low until cleaner data accumulate.
